blocks.scene: CHAPTER 51: THE HEARTH AT DAWN & THE CLOCKS OF MAJORA
blocks.text: Dawn broke across the timbered ridges of The Margin in long, fractured shafts of amber light, burning away the pine-scented mist that clung to the Appalachian sanctuary. Inside the central log house, the iron woodstove radiated a steady, comforting warmth, the aroma of sputtering batter and burnt dark sugar filling the common room. Pierre stood over the cast-iron skillet, a linen towel tucked into his stonemason's belt, his brow furrowed in severe Parisian critique as he flipped another golden pancake onto the platter.
